definitions.gloss: small cone of salt (for purification or luck)
definitions.explanation: A small heap or cone of salt set out at the entrance of a shop, restaurant or home to purify the place and invite good fortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{盛|も}り{塩|じお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a cone of salt at the entrance.
There's a cone of salt at the shop's entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{盛|も}り{塩|じお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{両脇|りょうわき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: At old-established restaurants, fresh cones of salt are set on both sides of the entrance every morning.

notes:
A custom connected with Shinto ideas of purification by salt, often seen at traditional restaurants and bars; it is also said to draw in customers.
